vectors.title: A private person is excluded; the family keeps its other parent and its children, and the father handle becomes null
A private family is excluded; the persons stay and lose their family references
A private event is excluded and its reference is removed from the person
A private note is excluded and removed from note_list
A private citation is excluded and removed from every citation_list, event references included
A private media object is excluded and its reference is removed
A private repository is excluded and the source loses that repository reference
A citation of a private source is excluded with it (it cannot exist without its source), and its references are filtered
A private place is excluded; an event naming it gets no place and a place under it loses its parent link
A new person whose primary name is private is held whole; the family forgets that parent and child
A synced person who later gets a private primary name is held: the cloud keeps the last synced version
Private secondary elements of a person are removed: alternate name, media reference, attribute, URL, address, LDS ordinance and association
A private event reference and a private child reference of a family are removed; an event reached only through a private reference is then excluded
Private media references (on events, places, sources, citations, families), private source attributes and a private repository reference are removed; the repository stays
A private attribute on an EventRef or a MediaRef is removed
Objects only a private person reaches are dropped, level by level: its event, notes, photos and citations; places and sources stay (exempt)
An event or note that a public person also references stays; an unreferenced note stays too
A childless family of two private parents is dropped; a family with a public child stays, with null parents
Objects only a held person references are dropped too
Places, sources and repositories only a private object reaches stay (exempt); the citation goes
